en-US.description: Serving professionals in the computer field
en-US.longDescription: CCFLink is a digital service platform built for computing professionals with the goal of creating more "connection" opportunities and the purpose of providing more comprehensive member services. It builds rich scenarios for online academic exchange, technical communication and industrial interaction, and fully mobilizes various online resources to serve its users.
